electrician_earnings_summary
statements:
create or replace function public.srk_get_my_earnings()
returns table(booking_id uuid, service_type text, completed_at timestamptz, booking_status text, payment_status text, amount_received numeric, commission_amount numeric, electrician_earning numeric)
language sql stable security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth, pg_temp
as $$
 select b.id, b.service_type, b.created_at, b.status, b.payment_status,
 coalesce(b.amount_paid,0), coalesce(b.commission_amount,0),
 case when b.status='completed' and b.payment_status='paid'
 then greatest(coalesce(b.amount_paid,0)-coalesce(b.commission_amount,0),0) else 0 end
 from public.electrician_profiles p join public.service_bookings b on b.assigned_electrician_id=p.id
 where p.user_id=auth.uid() and p.verification_status='approved'
 order by b.created_at desc limit 200;
$$;
revoke all on function public.srk_get_my_earnings() from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.srk_get_my_earnings() to authenticated;

rows.name: protect_commission_columns_and_admin_report
statements:
create or replace function public.srk_admin_commission_report()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not public.is_srk_admin() then
    raise exception 'Admin access required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  with paid_completed as (
    select assigned_electrician_id,
           coalesce(amount_paid,0)::numeric as gross,
           coalesce(commission_amount,0)::numeric as commission
    from public.service_bookings
    where status = 'completed' and payment_status = 'paid'
  ),
  totals as (
    select coalesce(sum(gross),0)::numeric as collected,
           coalesce(sum(commission),0)::numeric as commission,
           coalesce(sum(gross-commission),0)::numeric as payable
    from paid_completed
  ),
  partners as (
    select p.id as electrician_id,
           p.display_name,
           count(pc.*)::integer as paid_completed_jobs,
           coalesce(sum(pc.gross),0)::numeric as gross_received,
           coalesce(sum(pc.commission),0)::numeric as company_commission,
           coalesce(sum(pc.gross-pc.commission),0)::numeric as electrician_earning
    from public.electrician_profiles p
    left join paid_completed pc on pc.assigned_electrician_id = p.id
    group by p.id,p.display_name
    order by p.display_name
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'total_collected',t.collected,
    'total_commission',t.commission,
    'total_electrician_payable',t.payable,
    'partners',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(partners)) from partners),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v_result
  from totals t;

  return v_result;
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.srk_admin_commission_report() from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.srk_admin_commission_report() to authenticated;

set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth, pg_temp
as $$

         coalesce(b.amount_paid,0), coalesce(b.commission_amount,0),

rows.name: create_secure_wallet_ledger_foundation
create_server_only_razorpay_route_transfer_ledger
statements:
create table if not exists public.srk_route_transfers (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  booking_id uuid not null references public.service_bookings(id) on delete restrict,
  razorpay_payment_id text not null,
  recipient_type text not null check (recipient_type in ('electrician','platform_commission')),
  recipient_user_id uuid null references auth.users(id) on delete restrict,
  linked_account_id text null,
  transfer_id text null unique,
  idempotency_key text not null unique,
  amount_paise bigint not null check (amount_paise > 0),
  currency text not null default 'INR' check (currency = 'INR'),
  transfer_status text not null default 'not_created'
    check (transfer_status in ('not_created','created','pending','processed','failed','reversed','partially_reversed','manual_review')),
  settlement_status text not null default 'not_settled'
    check (settlement_status in ('not_settled','pending','on_hold','settled','reversed')),
  error_code text null,
  error_message text null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint srk_route_transfers_payment_recipient_uniq unique (razorpay_payment_id, recipient_type),
  constraint srk_route_transfers_recipient_check check (
    (recipient_type = 'electrician' and recipient_user_id is not null)
    or (recipient_type = 'platform_commission' and recipient_user_id is null)
  )
);
create index if not exists srk_route_transfers_booking_idx
  on public.srk_route_transfers (booking_id, created_at desc);
create index if not exists srk_route_transfers_status_idx
  on public.srk_route_transfers (transfer_status, settlement_status);
alter table public.srk_route_transfers enable row level security;
revoke all on table public.srk_route_transfers from anon, authenticated;
grant select, insert, update on table public.srk_route_transfers to service_role;
comment on table public.srk_route_transfers is
  'Server-only reconciliation ledger for Razorpay Route split transfers. No money movement is triggered by database writes.';
